ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor
